changes.name: UpgradePurchaseEffects
changes.source:
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService=game:GetService("TweenService")
local player=Players.LocalPlayer
local gui=player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"):WaitForChild("EnergyUI")

local function popup(name)
 local p=Instance.new("TextLabel")
 p.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,.5)
 p.Position=UDim2.new(.5,0,.42,0)
 p.Size=UDim2.new(0,360,0,80)
 p.BackgroundTransparency=1
 p.Text="UPGRADED!\n"..name
 p.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,225,80)
 p.TextStrokeTransparency=.25
 p.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBlack
 p.TextSize=30
 p.Parent=gui
 p.TextTransparency=1
 p.Size=UDim2.new(0,250,0,55)
 TweenService:Create(p,TweenInfo.new(.18,Enum.EasingStyle.Back,Enum.EasingDirection.Out),{TextTransparency=0,Size=UDim2.new(0,360,0,80)}):Play()
 task.delay(.65,function()
  if not p.Parent then return end
  local t=TweenService:Create(p,TweenInfo.new(.35),{TextTransparency=1,TextStrokeTransparency=1,Position=UDim2.new(.5,0,.37,0)})
  t:Play();t.Completed:Connect(function() p:Destroy() end)
 end)
end

local function pulseStat(search)
 for _,v in ipairs(gui:GetDescendants()) do
  if v:IsA("TextLabel") and string.find(string.lower(v.Text),string.lower(search),1,true) then
   local old=v.TextSize
   TweenService:Create(v,TweenInfo.new(.12,Enum.EasingStyle.Back),{TextSize=old+5}):Play()
   task.delay(.16,function() if v.Parent then TweenService:Create(v,TweenInfo.new(.18),{TextSize=old}):Play() end end)
   break
  end
 end
end

local watched={
 SpeedLevel={"SPEED","Speed:"},
 WorthLevel={"ENERGY WORTH","Energy per Orb:"},
 AmountLevel={"ENERGY AMOUNT","Maximum Orbs:"}
}
for valueName,data in pairs(watched) do
 local value=player:WaitForChild(valueName)
 local last=value.Value
 value:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
  if value.Value>last then popup(data[1]);pulseStat(data[2]) end
  last=value.Value
 end)
end

changes.name: UpgradeBoardEffects
changes.source:
local TweenService=game:GetService("TweenService")
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local world=workspace:WaitForChild("GrowIslandWorld")
local signs=world:WaitForChild("UpgradeSigns")
local mapping={SpeedLevel="SpeedLevelSign",WorthLevel="WorthLevelSign",AmountLevel="AmountLevelSign"}

local function flash(board)
 if not board then return end
 local light=board:FindFirstChildOfClass("PointLight")
 if light then
  local old=light.Brightness
  light.Brightness=4
  TweenService:Create(light,TweenInfo.new(.45),{Brightness=old}):Play()
 end
 local oldSize=board.Size
 TweenService:Create(board,TweenInfo.new(.12,Enum.EasingStyle.Back),{Size=oldSize+Vector3.new(.15,.7,.7)}):Play()
 task.delay(.14,function() if board.Parent then TweenService:Create(board,TweenInfo.new(.2),{Size=oldSize}):Play() end end)
end

local function hook(player)
 for valueName,boardName in pairs(mapping) do
  local value=player:WaitForChild(valueName)
  local last=value.Value
  value:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
   if value.Value>last then flash(signs:FindFirstChild(boardName)) end
   last=value.Value
  end)
 end
end
for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do task.spawn(hook,p) end
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(hook)
